card.statement:
Let $A$ be one of the following algebras:

-
Any subalgebra of invariants of $A_1(\mathbb{C})$ under the action of a finite group;

-
The ring of differential operators $\mathcal{D}(X)$, where $X$ is an smooth affine curve;

-
A generalized Weyl algebra of rank $1$ of simple classical or quantum type.

If $M$ is a finitely generated $A$-module then $GK (M) =1$ if and only if $M$ has a torsion.
card.label: Theorem 3

paper.title: Holonomic modules for rings of invariant differential operators
paper.abstract: We study holonomic modules for the rings of invariant differential operators on affine commutative domains with finite Krull dimension with respect to arbitrary actions of finite groups. We prove the Bernstein inequality for these rings. Our main tool is the filter dimension introduced by Bavula. We extend the results for the invariants of the Weyl algebra with respect to the symplectic action of a finite group, for the rings of invariant differential operators on quotient varieties, and invariants of certain generalized Weyl algebras under the linear actions. We show that the filter dimension of all above mentioned algebras equals 1.
